label: Indexical Checklist
description: A deliberately crude map of what a life contains — the brute categories an interviewer checks to avoid leaving whole regions of the self unasked.

regions.label: People
regions.oneLine: the people in your life — family, friends, mentors, the ones you've lost

regions.label: Places Lived
regions.oneLine: the places you've lived and what each one meant

regions.label: The Body
regions.oneLine: your relationship with your body — health, movement, illness, aging

regions.label: Money
regions.oneLine: money in your life — earning, spending, saving, what it means to you

regions.label: Obligations
regions.oneLine: the obligations you carry — the ones you chose and the ones you didn't

regions.label: The Dead
regions.oneLine: the people you've lost and how they stay present

regions.label: The Future
regions.oneLine: what you see ahead — the shape of it, the fears, the things you're building toward
